title: Favicon
slide_intent: Simplify identification only where space requires it because an abbreviated mark relies on existing recognition.
strategic_value: The two-color BK device can retain the burger silhouette on small social and digital surfaces.
demonstration: A small orange-and-red BK symbol is paired with a shaded clearspace diagram marked X; text explains its restricted use and rollout.
practical_value: Use the favicon only where the full logo would not be legible, retain its two colors and confirm market launch readiness.

content_islands.name: Favicon guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the small-size rationale, color restriction and market-rollout note in the left column.

content_islands.name: Favicon specimen
content_islands.spec: Show the small BK burger device near the upper center.

content_islands.name: Clearspace diagram
content_islands.spec: Show the matching symbol at right inside shaded clearance bands, with X measured from the K counter top to the bottom bun top.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains small-size legibility and says the two primary colors are essential to reading B and K.
reference_purposes.Expression: The compressed BK letters and buns preserve the burger form in two colors.
reference_purposes.Application: The page defines the vertical clearspace unit X using the K counter and bottom bun.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Do not use an alternate colorway or replace a legible full logo; launch follows identity establishment and consultation with the regional marketing communication lead.

ingredient.name: BK favicon
ingredient.role: Identify the brand at sizes where the full name cannot remain legible.
ingredient.application: Keep the supplied two-color asset; use X-based vertical clearance and use the full logo whenever it remains legible.
ingredient.scope: Historical rollout guidance; market release requires consultation and follows establishment of the new visual identity.
